question.text: Bank account details of a client during digital KYC can be verified through which mechanism?

answer.text: Penny Drop mechanism or any other mechanism using API of the Bank
Only by physically visiting the bank branch
Only through a letter from the bank manager
No verification of bank details is required

explanation.text: The Logic: During digital KYC, the client's bank account details are verified through the Penny Drop mechanism or any other mechanism that uses the API of the bank. The name and bank details returned by the verification must match what the client has provided. The Trap: Physical bank visits and bank manager letters are not the prescribed digital KYC route. Saying no verification is required is also wrong — bank account verification is part of the digital KYC process. Note: Both Penny Drop and other bank-API based methods are accepted; the workbook does not restrict verification to a single tool.
